#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const long long mask = (1LL << 31) - 1;

struct InputReader {
    std::istream& in;
    std::string token;
    std::stringstream ss;
    InputReader(std::istream& is) : in(is) {}
    std::string next() {
        while (!(ss >> token)) {
            std::getline(in, token);
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(token);
        }
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(next());
    }
};

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    for (; n > 0; n >>= 1) {
        if (n & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
    }
    return ret;
}

long long invl(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b, d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

long long modh(long long a, long long M, int h, int mod) {
    long long r = a - ((M * ((a & mask) >> 31)) + M * (a >> 31)) >> (h - 31) * 1LL * mod;
    return r < mod ? r : r - mod;
}

std::vector<long long> nttmb(const std::vector<long long>& src, int n, bool inverse, int P, int g) {
    std::vector<long long> dst(src);
    int h = 0;
    for (int x = n; x > 1; x >>= 1) h++;
    long long K = 1LL << (int)std::ceil(std::log2(P));
    int H = 0;
    for (long long x = K; x > 1; x >>= 1) H++;
    long long M = (K * K) / P;

    std::vector<int> wws(1 << (h - 1));
    long long dw = pow_mod(g, inverse ? P - 1 - (P - 1) / n : (P - 1) / n, P);
    long long w = (1LL << 32) % P;
    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - 1)); k++) {
        wws[k] = (int)w;
        w = (w * dw) % P;
    }
    long long J = invl(P, 1LL << 32);
    for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << i); j++) {
            int s = j << (h - i);
            int t = s | (1 << (h - i - 1));
            for (int k = 0, s1 = s, t1 = t; k < (1 << (h - i - 1)); k++, s1++, t1++) {
                long long u = (dst[s1] - dst[t1] + 2 * P) * wws[k] % P;
                dst[s1] = dst[s1] + dst[t1];
                if (dst[s1] >= 2 * P) dst[s1] -= 2 * P;
                long long Q = ((u << 32) * J) >> 32;
                dst[t1] = (u >> 32) - (Q * P >> 32) + P;
            }
        }
        if (i < h - 1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < (1 << (h - i - 2)); k++) {
                wws[k] = wws[k * 2];
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (dst[i] >= P) dst[i] -= P;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = std::reverse(i + 1, i + 1 + h) - 1;
        if (i < rev) {
            std::swap(dst[i], dst[rev]);
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        long long in = invl(n, P);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            dst[i] = (dst[i] * in) % P;
        }
    }
    return dst;
}

std::vector<long long> convoluteSimply(const std::vector<long long>& a, const std::vector<long long>& b, int P, int g) {
    int m = 1;
    int size = std::max((int)a.size(), (int)b.size());
    while (m < size) m <<= 1;
    m <<= 1; // ensure power of two
    auto fa = nttmb(a, m, false, P, g);
    auto fb = (a == b) ? fa : nttmb(b, m, false, P, g);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        fa[i] = (fa[i] * fb[i]) % P;
    }
    return nttmb(fa, m, true, P, g);
}

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    int N = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    std::vector<long long> dig(11, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x = in.nextInt();
        dig[10 - x] = 1;
    }
    int power = N / 2;
    std::vector<long long> res(1, 1);
    while (power > 0) {
        if (power & 1) {
            res = convoluteSimply(res, dig, MOD, 3);
        }
        dig = convoluteSimply(dig, dig, MOD, 3);
        power >>= 1;
    }
    long long output = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < res.size(); i++) {
        output += res[i] * res[i];
        output %= MOD;
    }
    std::cout << output << "\n";
    return 0;
}
